canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ulon Wyrek: 21-year-old man, 190 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: square compact face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, medium-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: an extensive but nonmagical geometric tattoo language across both arms; a shaped cloth clasp. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
